page.layout: One page of text: a Latin verse passage in italic lines, set in the full column. Running head top left, page number top right, signature at the foot left.

p.i: Et quos non satiat quicquid humus tenet,
Fac vt lata maris flumina forbeant.
Ponto sylua minax quo propere ruat.
Et vos, lecta virûm robora, connocat
Suetos ferre feri Martis opus graue,
Quò tantæ fugiunt tam trepidæ rates,
Infundúmque trahit, funda nec hos iuuat.
Et quæ turba sequens? Tarraco quos dedit

page.notes: Line 16 "Inniclàque": the word is partly unclear in the scan; read as Inniclaque with [?]. Line 21 "Vandallogoticum": the bracket and the word are faint; read with [?]. Line 20 "seruitium": read from a faint scan, possibly "feruitium". Signature "B. j" is followed by a small superscript mark that could not be read with certainty. The verse lines are each given as their own paragraph, following the rule for lines of verse. Long s has been normalised to s throughout; accents as printed.
